content: Ikɔ̈b a Yɛsu kyan'fà ken?
Yàmɛnà naa ilä mwɛy, Yɛsu kàkäl mulɔŋ baar u ndwà a Nzam anà mupay Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ. Amfum a angaŋ, alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn anà andweer bàyi
mukun'fuul naa: « Ikyään, unsà ikɔ̈b nà akakyerà ngye indiir abi, nà kapɛ ikɔ̈b udu a bya? »
Yɛsu kafuur naa: « Mɛ sye in'kwen mukàlafuul undiir mwɛy. Lan'kyään:
Ywan nà kun'töm mudümà baar? Du lɛɛ baar? »
Wɛɛ ba bàbulà muyweer ba a ba naa: « Bi isàfuur naa: "Du kun'töm", nde ayifuul naa: "Ntɔn nkye mpa lun'kyey bɛ?"
Wɛɛ bi isàtɛn naa: "Baar bun'töm", baar banswà bàyilom in'kul, ntɔn ba bàkyàyöb naa Ywan kàkäl ŋangɔɔm. »
Apan ba bun'fuur naa: « Bi iyöb anki naa nde kàfü ken. »
Yɛsu waa kàtɛn a ba naa: « Aay, mɛ sye alàkyään anki naa nà kan'pɛ mbwo mukyer indiir abi. »
Akyeer a man abe

Apan nde kàfàtɛɛl un'sɛŋ nsim yi: « Mbuur mwɛy kàkön ywaŋ a vin. Nde kàsɔ̈ɔ̈m la akà baar bàfàkyer vin ntɔn ba bàkyer isal aba uboo kwo. Ungö nde kàkyen nsi a kwɛl. Nde kwo kàkyer taaŋ mbɔɔn.
Taaŋ abwo mbɛŋ làkwe la, nde kàtöm un'syääl ande mwɛy akà baar aban ntɔn ba bun'pɛ kab lànde. Wɛɛ akyeer a man laa bàdüb ba un'syääl awun, waa kàfurà an'kɔɔ ipɔl.
Ŋaywaŋ kàtöm un'syääl asin. Nde awà sye bàkyer un'düb, bàkyer un'to, waa bun'fuur an'kɔɔ ipɔl.
Nde kàfàtɔm un'syääl wàtär. Awun sye bun'yɔ̈ɔ̈l, waa bun'böŋ.
Ŋaywaŋ kàyweer naa: "Mɛ in'kyer aben? Mɛ in'tɔm mwan baal amɛ in'fàkwen mɛ, mɛ in'sii naa ba bàkyer akun'sà làkoo."
Wɛɛ mpal bun'mɛn akyeer a vin, ba bàyweerà ba a ba naa: "Làler ikyee! Yää bi kun'dwä waa ywaŋ a vin làyàbulà làbi."
Laa bun'böŋ ba, waa bun'dwä. « Apan ŋaywaŋ asàkyer aben ntɔn ba?
Nde ŋakwo akyer asàyà, nde asàdwa akyeer a man abà banswà, waa usàsɔɔm ywaŋ akà baar asin. » Mpal bàwem baar ndaa ayi yanswà, ba bàtɛn naa: « Ndaa a tub ayi isàbwà anki! »
Wɛɛ Yɛsu kaler nde, waa kàtɛn naa: « Ndaa bàsön yi iswaŋà aben:
« Mbuur wanswà asàbwà udu a nkɔŋ ayin akyer asàbɔɔ. Wɛɛ isàkal naa nkɔŋ ayi yan'bweel mbuur, nde akyer asàpää nwamnwam. »
Itɛr bàfür akà Sɛzar
Taaŋ nsil alan, alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn anà amfum a angaŋ bàkwen mukɔr Yɛsu, ntɔn ba bàkyer ayöb naa nde nsim yi ba kàtɛɛl, wɛɛ ba bàtiinà un'seŋ bɔɔmà.

Apan ba bàsɛmà musey Yɛsu. Lalan bun'tööm ba baar bàfakurà naa ba bà baar aŋàbwaŋ. Baar abà bàlàlwab Yɛsu ndaa unsà mfuul mwɛy ntɔn ba bàwɛl iböŋ mukun'yälà akà abyääl anà akà mfum a nsi.
Baar aban bàtɛn a nde naa: « Un'lɔɔŋ, bi ikyàyöb naa ndaa afàtɛn ngye anà afàlɔŋ ngye yà ndandaa. Ngye afàler anki ntabwey a mbuur mupà nde ikwàndwà, wɛɛ ngye afàlɔŋ ndandaa mbwo a Nzam.
Wɛɛ bi ikwen muyöb naa nkye un'kɔɔn abi kà ipaa mbwo bi mufur itɛr akà Sɛzar lɛɛ tɛy? »
Wɛɛ Yɛsu kàyöb nkwɛɛr a ba, waa kàtɛn a ba naa:
« Lan'swɛŋ itɛr a ngim. Ntabwey anà ikɔb ki udu a kya byà nà? » Ba bàfuur naa: « Byà Sɛzar. »
Apan Yɛsu kàtɛn a ba naa: « Abun, làpɛ yà Sɛzar akà Sɛzar, yà Nzam akà Nzam. »
Lalan ba bàsàman anki ube unsà yinà yanswà kàtɛɛnà nde u mii a baar. Ba bàkäl mubem mfuur ande, ba ndaa bàfàsà anki.
Mfuul ntɔn ngwiiyà a akü
Yàmɛnà naa Asadusu amwɛy bàyi akà Yɛsu. Ba baar bàfàtɛn naa akü bàfàwiyà anki. Ba bun'fuul,
waa bàtɛn a nde naa: « Un'lɔɔŋ, Mɔsɛ kà ipɛ un'kɔɔn aŋàsɔn: "Isàkal naa mbuur aŋàkwɛl kan'kwà ukɔɔn asàwɛy baan, un'tɔŋ ande asàwal un'kyay kàkäl wànde ntɔn mupà ikyee akà un'kü."
Kyekà, bàkäl anà atɔŋ nsambwaar. Wàtàtwɛb kàkyer abääl, ungö waa kàkü ukɔɔn abɔr.
Wàyweel waa kàbääl un'kaar kàsàwɛy bweel ande,
wàtär sye abun. Ya yàkäl abun ntɔn ba bànsambwaar: ba bàkü ukɔɔn abɔr.
Ungö apan un'kaar sye waa kàkü.
Abun, ilä bàsàwiyà akü, un'kaar awà asàkal un'kyay a nà? Ntɔn ba bànsambwaar bàkyer un'bääl. »
Wɛɛ Yɛsu kafuur naa: « Abaal anà akaar a nsi yi bàkyer afàbääl,
wɛɛ abaal anà akaar bàsɔ̈ɔ̈l muwiyà kà ukwà anà mukal anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ taaŋ làsàyà, bàsàbääl anki.
Ba bàfàsàkwà anki, ba bà asànaa akyeey a du. Ba bà baan a Nzam, ntɔn ba baan a ngwiiyà.
Mɔsɛ ŋakwo kàtɛn ubwaŋàbwaŋ naa akü bàkyer asàwiyà. Uboo a nsim a ibwiy a mbaa, nde Mwol Nzam kun'bel Nzam a Abàlam, Nzam a Isak, Nzam a Yakɔb. »
Yɛsu kàfàkwɛy naa: « Mwol wà Nzam a baar a möö, nde kà wà Nzam a akü anki, ntɔn akà nde baar banswà bye anà mɔ̈ɔ̈. »
Alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn amwɛy bàtɛn a nde naa: « Un'lɔɔŋ, ngye an'tɛn ubwaŋ. »
Abun ba nde ndaa bàfun'fuul anki.
Klistɔ anà David
Yɛsu kàtɛn a ba naa: « Ban'kwo mutɛn aben naa Klistɔ wà mwan a David?
Ntɔn David atɛɛnà nde ŋakwo uboo a un'kaan a an'diim naa: "Mwol kàtɛn akà Mwol amɛ: "Bwaay u kɔɔ amɛ là ibaal,
mɛ in'kwen mubwiy ayiiŋ angye ntɔn ba bàbulà ikal angye mutɔɔl in'kɔl."
David kun'bel Mwol: Klistɔ kan'kwo mufàkal mwan a David? »
Yɛsu wàmuswaŋ baar naa ba bàkäl kà igyɛɛŋ ntɔn alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn.
Ilä mwɛy, mpal kàkäl un'sɛŋ wanswà mulab an'lɔɔŋ ande, Yɛsu kàtɛn a alɔŋki ande naa:

« Làkäl kà igyɛɛŋ ntɔn alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn: isal aba uyilyaaŋ anà mvwɛl anà bàfàkwɛn naa bàyapà mbɔr u balàbal. Ba bàfàsɔɔl an'kir amà kusà uboo a ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà anà ikal a làkoo u mɛsà adyà a kölàköl.
Ba bàfàduum indiir a akweel a adim byanswà, taaŋ nsil alan ba bàfàsà ngyamàkà a bwɛlàbwɛl ntɔn baar bamɛn: nsaŋ aba isàkal yà kölàköl. »
